en_h: After your transplant, what was the first thing you did that kidney or liver failure had taken from you?
qen: Reply to this story. It comes to my DMs, nobody else sees it.
ar: بعد الزراعة، شو أوّل شي عملتو كان فشل الكلى أو الكبد حارمك منّو؟
qar: ردّ عالستوري، بتوصل عالخاص وما حدا غيري بيشوفها.
en: After your transplant, what was the first thing you did that kidney or liver failure had taken from you?
